agent.name: Team Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Current landscape intelligence, alternatives, dependencies and monitoring

analytical_question: Can the company approve a Trainium2 commitment based solely on a claimed 30–40% price-performance advantage?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-17, the supplied historical AWS launch verifies that a rented ASIC option was announced with a stated comparator. Independent current evidence about relative accelerator maturity and workload costs is unavailable in this snapshot.
application_finding: A matched vision workload on the current GPU baseline and the ASIC would be needed to test the claim at the same model quality and latency.
organization_specific_finding: With limited engineering bandwidth and variable demand, a fixed commitment depends on current quotas, acceptable terms, measured porting effort and representative trial results.

evidence.claim: AWS announced rentable Trainium2 and claimed 30–40% better price-performance against EC2 P5e/P5en.
evidence.notes: Dated comparator-specific claim, excluded from local cost estimates.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The dated AWS 30–40% comparison applies to its stated EC2 comparators. Exclude it from forecasts until a matched workload and current commercial terms reproduce an advantage.
Independent corroboration and current commercial terms are unavailable.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the historic claim attribution; insufficient evidence for savings, ranking or a commitment.
value_opportunity_implication: A capped reversible trial could establish whether a port is worth pursuing.
risk_governance_implication: Finance retains spend approval and cloud operations enforces regional and contractual controls.
recommendation_management_implication: Defer commitment and request a matched benchmark and current quotes.
change_monitoring_triggers: ML lead and finance, after the first capped trial: reconsider an ASIC trial extension only if measured cost per accepted image improves under the same quality and latency gates after porting costs.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Require independent applicable evidence or a representative paired local benchmark, plus comparable quotes, quotas and contract terms.
